svg.title: Service and AI model availability in six regions
svg.desc: Whether three managed services (Kubernetes, serverless functions, PostgreSQL) and three groups of frontier AI models are available in six regions (US East, Frankfurt, Singapore, Tokyo, Sao Paulo and Sydney) of AWS, Azure and Google Cloud as of 2026-10-26. A check mark on green means available, a cross on orange means not available, and a dash on grey means no data. Hover a cell for the region code and access mode.
